title: Inori's Homunculus Tears Yuri Novel Gets Manga by Ayster, Dokico
content: German publisher Dokico announced on Saturday that Ayster will draw a manga adaptation of author Inori 's Homunculus Tears: Alchemy for the Brokenhearted ( Homunculus no Namida ~Kietai Kimi e no Renkinjutsu~ ) novel. Dokico will begin releasing the manga in German, English, and Japanese simultaneously in January 2027.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Renai Rubi no Tadashii Furikata Season 2 Reveals More Cast, October 29 Debut
content: The official website for the second season of the live-action series of Ogeretsu Tanaka 's Renai Rubi no Tadashii Furikata (The Right Way to Write Love) boys-love manga revealed more cast members, the October 29 debut on Tokyo MX1, and a new visual for the second season on October 7.
author: ANN

title: 'Kino no Tabi' Creator Duo Begins New Light Novel
content: Publishing company Kadokawa announced on Friday that author Keiichi Sigsawa and illustrator Kouhaku Kuroboshi , the duo behind the Kino no Tabi: The Beautiful World ( Kino's Journey: The Beautiful World ) light novel, will launch a new light novel titled Drifted: John Smith no Edo Hyouryuu Kitan .
author: MyAnimeList

title: The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady's Treasure Film's New Video Reveals Bi Clan's Cast
content: TOHO animation began streaming a character trailer for The Apothecary Diaries : The Late Lady's Treasure ( Kusuriya no Hitorigoto: Bо̄hi no Hihо̄ ), the upcoming anime film based on Hyuganatsu and Touko Shino 's The Apothecary Diaries ( Kusuriya no Hitorigoto ) light novel series, on Monday.

title: Idol Group i☆Ris to End Activities in 2027
content: Voice actress idol unit i☆Ris announced on Sunday on their official website that they will end their activities at the end of 2027, coinciding with the group's 15th anniversary and marking the conclusion of their 15-year journey.
